Migration adds nullable issue_date, backfills, makes NOT NULL, swaps unique index, has down() (2026_10_29_000002...:14-55). nextCode filters by queue+issue_date and prefix pattern, skips malformed, ignores A codes (app/Models/Ticket.php:288-310). IssueTicket reads now() once for code day/issued_at/issue_date (IssueTicket.php:33-50). Factory aligns issue_date to issued_at and allocates by priority/day (TicketFactory.php:374-435). UpdateQueue priorityPrefixMap null/[]/validate -> ValidationException key priority_prefix_map before any mutation (UpdateQueue.php:66-72,81-83). Docs updated. Small gaps: down() re-adding unique(queue_id, code) will fail once daily-restarted codes repeat across days; ValidationException import in UpdateQueue is not visible in the diff (presumably already present).

conventions.evidence: Domain write stays in UpdateQueue action with Gate authorization first (UpdateQueue.php:64); casts and $fillable kept deliberate; docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md updated under [Unreleased]. But the TDD rule 'everything implemented ships with a test' is not followed: new Queue validation, UpdateQueue parameter, prefixes P/E and daily restart have no tests. Migration file names 2026_10_29_000001/000002 look hand-written rather than generated by make:migration.

security.evidence: priority_prefix_map not added to #[Fillable] (Queue.php:104 unchanged); UpdateQueue authorizes via Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('update', $queue) before validating/storing (UpdateQueue.php:64-72); map validated server-side on every save via saving hook; IssueTicket keeps forceCreate with trusted system data only. tests.evidence: Only tests/Feature/IssueTicketTest.php changed, mostly renaming A->N expectations, plus issue_date==issued_at date check and a legacy A001 -> N001 test (lines 652, 701-711). No tests for P/E prefixes or independent per-prefix sequences, daily restart, the custom map (prefixForPriority), map validation (bad keys '010'/'-1'/'foo', 'xx' values, duplicate effective prefixes, empty->null), UpdateQueue priorityPrefixMap (null/[]/invalid -> ValidationException, queue unchanged, unauthorized actor), or the factory issued_at=2026-09-28 case.

simplicity.evidence: Core logic is direct, but TicketFactory::configure grows a convoluted queue resolution (relationLoaded / getAttribute('queue') / queue_id instanceof Queue / Queue::find) at TicketFactory.php:390-424; UpdateQueue validates up front and then catches InvalidArgumentException again around save with refresh() (UpdateQueue.php:66-72 and 87-90), redundant; validatePrefixMap has redundant checks ($map === [] early return, '$intKey === null' guard, comment about duplicate keys). Migration backfill updates row by row in PHP instead of one UPDATE ... DATE(issued_at).

readability.evidence: Clear names and PHPDoc (Ticket::nextCode docblock updated, Queue::defaultPrefixFor); comments explain the single clock read. Minor: untyped $issueDate parameter with docblock union in nextCode/normalizeIssueDate (Ticket.php:288,315), verbose branching in validatePrefixMap and factory.

scope.evidence: All touched files serve the task: models, actions, factory, two migrations, docs (business-rules, database-schema, CHANGELOG, plus the code-format sentence in docs/api/totem.md that would otherwise be stale), and test updates.

issues.explanation: Most new behavior is untested: P/E prefixes and independent sequences, daily restart, custom per-queue map, map validation rules, UpdateQueue priorityPrefixMap (including invalid map and unauthorized actor) and the factory's past-day allocation.
down() re-adds unique(queue_id, code), which fails once daily-restarted codes (e.g. N001 on two days) exist, so the rollback is not reliably reversible.
Queue resolution in the factory covers speculative cases (queue_id holding a Queue instance, lazy getAttribute('queue'), extra find) and is far more than needed to pick the prefix.
The map is already validated before mutation, so catching InvalidArgumentException around save() and refresh()ing is redundant duplicated handling.
Sequential 000001/000002 timestamps suggest hand-named migrations instead of php artisan make:migration as the conventions require.
Backfill issues one UPDATE per row in PHP; a single UPDATE setting issue_date from issued_at would be simpler and faster on large tables.
$issueDate is left untyped with a docblock union rather than a native union type, and defaults (prefix 'N', today) hide required context at call sites.

review.summary: The change implements priority-letter prefixes with a validated per-queue override map, a daily issue_date sequence with migration and new unique index, single-clock issuance, factory alignment, the UpdateQueue parameter and the doc updates, and the logic looks correct. However, it ships almost no tests for the new behavior (only existing IssueTicket expectations were renamed), which goes against the project's TDD rule. It also has a fragile migration down() and some unnecessary complexity in the factory and UpdateQueue, so it needs changes before merging.
